acceptanceCriteria: A first import of the 2,894-item Beamfall export spends per-batch model time proportional to the records the batch writes, shown by a CPU profile in which transaction.Model no longer grows with the store size.
The first import of that export is re-measured on a host with load below the CPU count and recorded against CAL-V0-018 in docs/specs/corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0.md.
body:
CAL-V0-018 (S6) now carries one import audit across IMPORT_APPLY batches, but each batch still calls transaction.Model with every stored ticket. validateInput decodes, canonicalizes and digest-checks all of them, and CheckCapacity re-measures the whole inventory. In the full-export profile (docs/build-log/2026-09-27-corvint-tasks-import-cost.md) Model took 112 s of 208 s of CPU samples: validateInput 74 s, CheckCapacity 36 s. Both grow with the store, so a first import is quadratic in the export size. The 271 s measurement was also taken at load 37 to 60 on 12 CPUs, so the CAL-V0-018 load condition is NOT_MET. Removing the terms needs an incremental model input (a carried, already-validated ticket inventory and capacity total), which widens the pure model's trust boundary and needs a spec amendment.
